plays.title: Sac bunt, runners 1st & 2nd
plays.game: Atlanta Braves @ Los Angeles Dodgers · NLDS 'B' Game 2
plays.players: 3B Max Muncy; 2B Tommy Edman
plays.description: With runners on 1st and 2nd and nobody out, the 3B charges the sacrifice bunt and throws to the 2B, who is covering first. The runners move up to 2nd and 3rd.
plays.official_play: Mike Yastrzemski out on a sacrifice bunt, third baseman Max Muncy to second baseman Tommy Edman. Brewer Hicklen to 3rd. Austin Riley to 2nd.
plays.situation: 0 out, runners on 1B, 2B; ATL 3 - LAD 1 (after play)
plays.coaching_point: Standard (non-wheel) bunt coverage: the 3B and 1B crash, the SS holds at 2nd, and the 2B covers 1st, so nobody is covering 3rd. With the 3B charging and no one at the bag, there is no force at 3rd, so he takes the sure out at first. To get the lead runner at 3rd you need a wheel play, where the SS rotates over to cover 3rd.
plays.original_coaching_point: With runners on 1st and 2nd, the corners crash and the 2B has to get to first. If the 3B can't get the lead runner, he takes the sure out at first; don't throw the ball away chasing the force at 3rd.
